title: dispatch.rs SEARCH arm is a silent internal-error path that should be unreachable
description: reader/src/session/dispatch.rs line 199-203 has a SEARCH arm that returns Response::new(500, 'Internal error: SEARCH not intercepted'). A comment says this should be unreachable because lifecycle.rs intercepts it before dispatch. This is a hidden ordering invariant: if any future refactor routes SEARCH through dispatch() (e.g. by reordering the if-let chains in run_command_loop), clients get a 500 instead of a correct SEARCH response. The invariant exists only in comments, not enforced by the type system. Maintenance consequence: the next person who moves command dispatch into a single match statement will silently break SEARCH.
